body: Michael Olosky (CEO) on 2025-10-27 (Q3-2025 earnings call transcript (Motley Fool)): "As a result of these actions, we expect to generate annualized cost savings of at least $30 million with one-time charges of approximately $9 million to $12 million that will be realized in fiscal 2025."
